stem.text: Which statement about the electromotive force (e.m.f.) of a cell is **always** correct?

A.text: The e.m.f. is the energy converted from electrical to other forms in the cell.

B.text: The e.m.f. is the energy provided by the cell per unit charge passing through it.

C.text: The e.m.f. is the potential difference across the internal resistance of the cell.

D.text: The e.m.f. is the potential difference across the terminals of the cell.
